--config-path.help: Searches for config.yaml from given directory. If not set, tries to find it from YaraHunter binary's and current directory

--container-ns.help: Namespace of existing container to scan, empty for docker runtime

--debug-level.help: Debug levels are one of FATAL, ERROR, IMPORTANT, WARN, INFO, DEBUG. Only levels higher than the debug-level are displayed

--enable-updater.help: Download rules at runtime if not present (Default: false)

--fail-on-count.help: Exit with status 1 if number of malwares found is >= this value (Default: -1)

--fail-on-high-count.help: Exit with status 1 if number of high malwares found is >= this value (Default: -1)

--fail-on-low-count.help: Exit with status 1 if number of low malwares found is >= this value (Default: -1)

--fail-on-medium-count.help: Exit with status 1 if number of medium malwares found is >= this value (Default: -1)

--fail-on-rule-compile-warn.help: Fail if yara rule compilation has warnings

--host-mount-path.help: If scanning the host, specify the host mount path for path exclusions to work correctly.

--http-port.help: When set the http server will come up at port with df es as output

--image-name.help: Name of the image along with tag to scan for IOC

--inactive-threshold.help: Threshold for Inactive scan in seconds

--license.help: TheratMapper or ThreatStryker license, also supports env var DEEPFENCE_LICENSE

--local.help: Specify local directory (absolute path) which to scan. Scans only given directory recursively.

--log-level.help: Log levels are one of error, warn, info, debug. Only levels higher than the log-level are displayed

--product.help: Deepfence Product type can be ThreatMapper or ThreatStryker, also supports env var DEEPFENCE_PRODUCT

--rules-listing-url.help: Deepfence threat intel yara rules listing (Default: threat-intel.deepfence.io/yara-rules/listing.json)

--rules-path.help: All .yar and .yara files in the given directory will be compiled

--socket-path.help: The gRPC server unix socket path

--standalone-http-port.help: use to run malware scanner as a standalone service

--temp-directory.help: Directory to process and store repositories/matches

--threads.help: Number of concurrent threads (default number of logical CPUs)

--workers-per-scan.help: Number of concurrent workers per scan
